'''''Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral''''' is a five-part [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]. It ties in with Miller's ''[[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith]]'' eBook series.

The story occurs around [[2974 BBY]], approximately one year after the events of the ebook ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium]]''.<ref name="Miller" /> ''Spiral'' is set on the remote planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], which was home to a stranded group of [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] known as the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. The story arc focuses on the adventures and experiences of the young Tribal outcast [[Parlan Spinner]] and his former enemy–turned–companion [[Takara Hilts]], a Sith princess and the daughter of [[Grand Lord]] [[Varner Hilts]]. A large element on the plot deals with the threat posed to the Lost Tribe by the ancient [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Remulus Dreypa]], who had been freed from his [[Oubliette (stasis casket)|oubliette]] by Parlan.

''Spiral'' was first released on [[August 8]], [[2012]] and ran until [[December 12]], 2012. It consists of five issues and its script was developed by Miller, who had also co-authored the ''Lost Tribe of the Sith'' short story series. [[Randy Stradley]] announced on the Dark Horse message boards that the series would end after the fifth comic issue.<ref name="DHmb">{{DHBoards|url=viewtopic.php?f=1&t=19481&p=260591#p260591|thread=Star Wars Series Update Request|user=[[Randy Stradley]]|date=2012-06-18|time=8:47 pm}}</ref>
